tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (13.4:1).

tokens.name: color-naval-navy
tokens.usage: Deep ocean authority, club formality. Used as text on `.club-crest`, `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
